title.zh: Vitalik：未来两年AI或冲击抗量子密码安全，但不建议用户仓促转移资产
title.en: Vitalik：未来两年AI或冲击抗量子密码安全，但不建议用户仓促转移资产

current_state.zh: Vitalik Buterin warned that AI-accelerated mathematics could weaken lattice-based post-quantum cryptography such as ML-DSA and FHE — and eventually ECDSA — within about two years, prompting Ethereum's Lean roadmap to favor pure hash-based signatures, while advising users not to hastily move assets but to prefer unused addresses and offline multisig signing.
